vitest.command: DATABASE_URL=<disposable> DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=<disposable> npx vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts tests/postgres/user-export-session.pg.test.ts

assertions: A valid HMAC-SHA256 Better Auth session cookie resolves the live PostgreSQL session.
The authenticated user is resolved to an actor using current database state.
A cookie signed with a different secret is rejected.
A previously valid cookie is rejected after its database session is revoked.
scope_limits: The test calls getAuth and resolveDbBackedActor directly; it does not launch Next HTTP.
The separate export route PostgreSQL test still mocks auth and rate limiting.
This does not complete K27-T1/T2, K05/K11/K26/K37 dependencies, or independent review.
